user.title: Adaptive Lightning
user.description: Choose the lights to adapt. Whenever one of them is turned on, by anything, its brightness and colour temperature are set from the sun's position and the time of day.

data.min_kelvin: Warmest colour temperature (night, sun below horizon)
data.wind_down_start: Start dimming for the night at
data.continuous: Keep adjusting lights that are on
data.turn_on_transition: Transition when a light turns on

data_description.min_kelvin: Each light is additionally limited to the range it supports.
data_description.afternoon_shift: How much warmer the light is when the sun is in the west, compared with the same elevation in the morning.
data_description.continuous: A light you adjust by hand is left alone until it is turned off and on again.
data_description.use_weather: On overcast days the light gets slightly warmer and brighter. Requires a weather entity below.

error.kelvin_range: The coolest temperature must be higher than the warmest.
error.brightness_order: Brightness must satisfy: night ≤ evening ≤ daytime.
error.weather_required: Select a weather entity or turn the weather option off.
